description: Equipements - Gares is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. Location of the 10 stations of the territory. Extraction of the layer of public transit stops. Contains the same STIF data. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. The portal shows the English title as "Equipment - Stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. Its keywords include rer, gare, deplacement, transport, ligne-h, geospatial. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WEB PAGE, GPKG, ZIP, GDB. The listing shows 2017-08-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
